description: Independent earner tax credit (New Zealand) [NZ]. Works out the yearly NZ independent earner tax credit (IETC): the full amount between the lower and upper income limits, reducing above that, and nothing for people excluded by Working for Families, NZ Super or a benefit.

excluded.description: You or your partner get Working for Families, or you get NZ Super, a benefit or a similar pension
